ZFF95NLAXN0274146.notes: This 2022 Ferrari SF90 Stradale in White is for sale at Sienna Collection in Pompano Beach, Florida, and the window sticker is the reason to look closely. Original MSRP was $625,550, which reflects more than $107,000 in factory options and personalization on top of a $513,691 starting price. It is a low-mileage, pre-owned coupe with a black leather interior and an option list that is long even by Ferrari standards. The powertrain is a plug-in hybrid: a 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8 working with three electric motors for 986 combined horsepower. An 8-speed F1 dual-clutch transmission and e4WD all-wheel drive put that output to the road. The single largest option is the Extended Livery on Bumpers at $21,936. Next come Dual-Color Leather Interior Trim at $8,437, the Carbon Fiber Driver Zone with LED steering wheel at $7,602, the Suspension Lifter at $5,737 and Carbon Fiber Upper Tunnel Trim at $4,050. Smaller selections include the AFS Adaptive Front Lighting System, Scuderia Ferrari Shields at $1,866, Black Ceramic Exhaust Pipes at $1,687, Blue Brake Calipers at $1,519, Cavallino stitching on the headrests at $1,206 and Colored Inner Details at $1,181. Another $44,884 in additional factory and bespoke options completes the sticker. Chassis equipment matches the output. Carbon ceramic Brembo brakes are fitted front and rear, the magnetic suspension is driver adjustable, and a drive mode selector changes how the car responds. The LED steering wheel places progressive shift lights directly in the driver's line of sight, framed by exposed carbon fiber. A head-up display, hard-drive navigation with real-time traffic, a rearview camera, rear parking sensors, HomeLink and an electrochromic rearview mirror cover everyday driving. Anyone comparing one 2022 Ferrari SF90 Stradale with another should study the original specification, because cars that look alike can differ by tens of thousands of dollars in carbon fiber, livery, lift systems and interior materials.

You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back! Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it.

You checked the mirror, looked over your shoulder and still nearly collided with the car next to you. An active blind spot system not only alerts you to the presence of a vehicle to your sides or rear but helps prevent you from making an unsafe lane change. Replace fear and uncertainty with the confidence and safety of the Active blind spot system. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. What this vehicle includes: Protection Package Premier ($700 value) Bumper Cover License Plate Frame Rubber Floor Mats Polishing Cloth Cargo Tray Wheel Locks Safety and Security Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Brake assist boosts emergency stopping power when you need it most, detecting panic braking and applying maximum available force to help shorten stopping distances. Standard cruise control with steering wheel controls keeps speed adjustments intuitive and within easy reach, helping reduce leg fatigue and maintain steady highway efficiency. The power open and close liftgate makes loading and unloading effortless when your hands are full, allowing you to access the cargo area with minimal fuss. Heated driver and front passenger seats provide quick, localized warmth on chilly mornings, increasing comfort and helping you settle into the drive sooner.

Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back! Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them.
